evidence: Independent Am27S31 bytes at 0E0 match low-address handlers; 0F0 bytes match bank-200 branch targets; 080-0CF bytes point to short returning arithmetic paths in bank 200.
limitations: ROM bytes are measured; their association with microcode dispatch sites and high address bits remains a hypothesis.
All 80 entries from five 16-byte call tables are indexed uniformly by the scenario; physical row/index selection is unknown.
Repeated targets retain separate lookup indices; these are not inferred probabilities of real commands.
Lookup logs reconstruct the proposed address path from executed dispatches, not measured bus transfers.
Physical association of the Am27S31 with device 810241 on DSC3557 is still unconfirmed; DAC and sample clock connections remain unknown.
trace_selection: Seed 2 exercises 26F and 21F; seed 3 exercises 008. Selected for inspecting lookups, not as a coverage ranking.
